in_hebrew.name: גרוארק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'gar' which means 'strong' or 'mighty' and 'ark' which means 'box' or 'ark'. The name Groark can be interpreted as 'Strong one in the box' or 'Warrior in the ark'.

in_greek.name: Γροάρκ
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words 'gros' which means 'strong' and 'arkhē' which means 'ruler' or 'governor'. The name Groark can be interpreted as 'Strong ruler'.

in_latin.name: Groarcus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'grossus' which means 'strong' or 'large'. The name Groark can be interpreted as 'Strong one'.
